text:
Anya: quick design thread — attaching mock of the compact chat panel with live stream + token counter. thoughts?
Matt: looks great. question: when the stream is live, do we keep the token counter moving (live increment) or only update at pauses/regens?
Anya: preference is live increment but in a low-attention style (fade, no pulse). avoids surprise token jumps when users glance.
Sophia: +1 for live. but small concern about accessibility: screen readers should get an aria-live region only on final token count, otherwise it spams.
DesignBot: accessibility nits: use role/status for the token label and aria-atomic=true when updating final count.
Jess: fwiw we also need to show estimated token delta for "regenerate" to indicate cost-of-retry. small helper text? e.g., "~+45 tokens if regenerated"
Matt: I like the estimate, but it should be optional (toggle in prompt library settings). default off for newbies.
Ryan: related: stop vs pause UX — product asked for a single compact control. Should the primary be Stop (kill generation) and secondary Regenerate (re-run) or one button that toggles?
Anya: goal is clarity: Stop will cease generation and keep partial output. Regenerate triggers a full rerun (clear + new). So two clear actions, but in compact view we can show a single overflow menu with both for space reasons.
Sophia: mobile constraints: can't have three buttons. overflow menu + a primary FAB for Stop seems fine. primary label should be icon-only with tooltip.
Jess: copy proposals: Stop tooltip -> "Stop generation (keeps partial reply)". Regenerate -> "Regenerate reply (re-runs with same prompt)". Token estimate -> "Estimated regen cost"
Matt: microcopy tweak: use plain verbs: "Stop" and "Regenerate" are fine. avoid parentheses in tooltip; make sentences shorter.
Anya: proposal for token counter: tiny pill top-right of chat bubble showing two numbers: current / limit (e.g., 128/2048). When streaming, the current increments. on hover show breakdown (input vs output).
DesignBot: hover breakdown must be accessible on keyboard focus. Also provide a non-hover fallback (ellipsis button) to open breakdown panel.
Ryan: prompt library integration: users can pin a prompt from the library to appear as a compact badge above the composer. If pinned prompt changes, the token estimate should update live.
Sophia: attention: pinned prompts should show an editable preview mode so users know what will be sent. edit opens full prompt editor.
Jess: UX question: when user hits Regenerate, do we prefill a "confirm" for high-cost prompts (>1500 tokens)? or just show a cost toast?
Matt: for cost > threshold show inline confirmation modal with quick confirm checkbox — avoid blocking for small costs.
Anya: decision: show non-blocking toast for <=500 extra tokens; modal confirm for >500. Capture telemetry.
Ryan: implementation note for eng: we need an event for "regen_requested" that includes estimate_pre, estimate_post, pinned_prompt_id.
Anya: placeholder for visual: screenshot link — https://img.redwood.mock/ux/compact-stream-1977778888.png
Sophia: small accessibility nit for token pill: color contrast must pass 4.5:1. also make sure it doesn't rely on color alone — include chevrons or labels.
Jess: follow-up: can we show a micro animation when token count jumps >100 tokens so it's noticeable? subtle — no more than 300ms.
Matt: engineering concerns: continuous live updates at 60hz would be overkill. recommend batching updates every 200–300ms and debounce UI.
DesignBot: recommended spec: update interval=250ms, aria-live update for final only, hovered breakdown accessible via button with aria-expanded.
Anya: next steps: design to iterate mock with token pill variants (left-aligned vs top-right), compact toolbar layout with overflow menu, and tooltip microcopy options.
Ryan: I'll add a TODO in the product spec for telemetry and event names.
Jess: I'll draft final copy variants and share in thread by EOD.
Matt: I'll prototype the debounce and a11y hooks in the playground branch.
Anya: thanks — please ping when PRs land. :wave:
